head_commit.message:
fix(engine): restore outer budgets after nested queries (#6478)

* fix: restore outer query budgets after nested evaluations

Seal installation behind a private RAII scope and restore the complete prior limits and sticky error. Preserve all 14 production caller scopes, constrain raw snapshots to exec, and pin nested, unwind, cancellation, and byte-savepoint behavior.

Co-Authored-By: GPT-6 Astra <noreply@openai.com>

* test: clarify nested budget scopes and declare wasm intent

Refine the cancellation-pointer safety comments, pin serial callback evidence,
and assert idle state after SERVICE savepoint restoration. Format only touched
tests and restore incidental production reflows. Add PR 6478 V2 intent metadata
for the intentional always-compiled budget restoration.

Co-Authored-By: GPT-6 Astra <noreply@openai.com>

* test(engine): cover nested query execution errors

Keep parse rejection distinct from a valid unsupported graph query that exits after installing its child budget. Document independent nested scopes and restoration in the query skill and engine README.
